title: Ultrahuman pill button
description: A fully round pill button about 140px wide and 37px tall: the cobalt buy button, a white one for photos, a translucent glass one that fills with ink on hover, a solid ink one and a hairline outline. Colour and opacity ease over 275ms.
notes: glass is meant for photos: its text uses foreground, so place it where foreground reads (or under the dark class)
